shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a rectangular island stands between a sink counter and a refrigerator, with a window along one side and an aisle along the opposite side. A woman in an orange shirt sits at the refrigerator-side window stool and explains a stew recipe, a man in a white shirt sits at the sink-side window stool, and a woman in a blue shirt sits at the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the refrigerator end, looking along the kitchen island toward the sink counter, with both window-side stools and the sink-end stool and the sink counter in frame.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt asks about preparing vegetables, while a man in a white shirt objects to scraping ingredients, leaves his seat, and exits the kitchen.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side stools.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt discusses the remaining ingredients for the stew recipe.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the refrigerator-side window stool.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt explains the cooking time for the stew recipe.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the kitchen island.
